scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is conditional on compactly supported flow invariance and does not assert existence, ergodicity, mixing, or attraction of non-equilibrium states. The earliest verified public date in the source lineage is 1994-08-01 for Sprott's base case E; the quadratic three-parameter extension is documented in the 2013 Kybernetika source. All displayed stationary laws are proved from the stated vector field; numerical simulation is not used as proof.
title: Parameter-free stationary activity calibration in the quadratic-perturbed Sprott E family
